author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: A family of unit-clause CNF inputs, with repeated identical clauses retained and the source per-edge subdivision, admits specified balanced root packings with exp(Omega(M/sqrt(u))) retained odd-node Newton child-product summands nonzero at the source child precision.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the exact subdivided CNF construction, filler pinning lemma, Pascal/Boolean quotient and precision accounting
The construction depends on a specified valid packing and retention of repeated input clauses
No lower bound against preprocessing, default labeling or aggregation
A SAT improvement requires a uniform algorithm and complete cost analysis
